question: Atal Tunnel connects which two places?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Manali and Lahaul-Spiti valley __**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Tunnel:-**

 
 
• **It was formerly known as the Rohtang Pass Tunnel.**
 
• **It is a highway tunnel built under the Rohtang Pass in the eastern Pir Panjal range of the Himalayas on the National Highway 3 in Himachal Pradesh, India. **
 
• At 9.02 km (5.61 mi), it is the longest highway single-tube tunnel above 10,000 feet (3,048 m) in the world when completed and is named after former Prime Minister of India, Atal Bihari Vajpayee. 
 
• The construction of the Atal Tunnel was a major engineering challenge.
 
• The tunnel had to be built through a geologically unstable area and in harsh weather conditions.
 
• The tunnel was also built in an area with a high altitude, which made it difficult for workers to breathe and work for long periods of time.
 
• Despite the challenges, the construction of the Atal Tunnel was completed on record time.
 
• The tunnel was opened to traffic on 3 October 2020, after five years of construction.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shimla:-**

 
 
• **It is the capital of the state of Himachal Pradesh. **
 
• It is located in the foothills of the Himalayas and is known for its Victorian-era buildings, stunning views, and pleasant climate.
 
• Popular attractions in Shimla include the Ridge, a large open space with stunning views of the surrounding hills, the Christ Church, a beautiful Gothic-style church, and the Jakhoo Temple, an ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman.
 
 
 
• **Nainital:-**
 
 
• **It is a popular tourist destination in the state of Uttarakhand. **
 
• It is located around a beautiful lake called Naini Lake and is known for its colorful houses, picturesque surroundings, and numerous lakes and waterfalls.
 
• Popular attractions in Nainital include the Naini Lake, the Naina Devi Temple, a Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Naina Devi, and the Tiffin Top, a hilltop with stunning views of the surrounding mountains.
 
 
 
• **Mansoori:-**
 
 
• **It is a charming hill station in the state of Uttarakhand. **
 
• It is known as the "Queen of the Hill Stations" and is famous for its colonial architecture, stunning views, and pleasant weather.
 
• Popular attractions in Mansoori include the Kempty Falls, a series of waterfalls located near the town, the Gun Hill, the highest point in Mansoori with stunning views of the surrounding mountains, and the Mall Road, a bustling shopping street with numerous shops, restaurants, and cafes.
